nodes.label: Intervention Profile Contract
nodes.statement: Fix Pi, actual trial tokens P_omega/I_omega, internal slot family k, independently physically grounded J_B and J_T, tool-absent body readouts Y_B and tool-specific readouts Y_T, preregistered normalized effect bounds L/U and epsilon>0. Let a=delta(Y_B;J_B), x=delta(Y_B;J_T), b=delta(Y_T;J_B), y=delta(Y_T;J_T). Undefined or noncommensurable effects block classification rather than count as zero. Reports do not define these roles.
nodes.domain: Declared finite protocol only; J_B/J_T fidelity, readout semantics, normalization, error bounds and admissibility are simultaneous premises.
nodes.scope: Declared finite protocol only; J_B/J_T fidelity, readout semantics, normalization, error bounds and admissibility are simultaneous premises.
nodes.proof: Typed definition and preregistration package. The rational grid establishes abstract consistency only.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: No actual dataset or selective intervention is supplied; behavioral names do not ground pathways; unsafe interventions excluded.

formal_contract_R160.object_domain: Finite preregistered human upper-limb/tool-use trial family with independently grounded intervention and readout roles; actual execution is not claimed.
formal_contract_R160.quantifiers: For each fixed protocol Pi, candidate slot family k, declared normalized effect/error model and epsilon>0; no universal necessity, sufficiency, anatomical-membership or F_O equivalence.
formal_contract_R160.bearer_time_signature: Each trial fixes its own actual P_omega,I_omega,complete K_omega,D_omega,Phi_omega,h_omega. Participant lineage does not identify complete organizations across trials. Internal tokens and external referents retain different sorts.
formal_contract_R160.purpose: Give the R159 body-slot/tool-slot gap a falsifiable relative causal profile while preserving semantic and phenomenal limits.

nodes.label: Four-Way Body/Tool Profile
nodes.statement: Under the full profile contract, define B_Pi(k) iff L(a)>epsilon and L(a)-U(x)>epsilon; define T_Pi(k) iff L(y)>epsilon and L(y)-U(b)>epsilon. Exactly one Boolean pair (1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(0,0) holds, interpreted only as body-dominant, tool-dominant, overlap or neither in Pi. Positive off-diagonal effects are compatible with every class.
nodes.domain: Exactly one fixed Pi/effect/error model satisfying every R160 profile premise.
nodes.scope: Exactly one fixed Pi/effect/error model satisfying every R160 profile premise.
nodes.proof: Boolean exhaustiveness gives four cases. The 3/4,1/4,1/4,3/4 matrix at epsilon=1/4 witnesses overlap with positive cross-effects; 625 exact grid matrices show all four classes, including under positive off-diagonals.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A category is not anatomical membership, complete mechanism, external-reference correctness or F_O. Grid counts are not population frequencies.

nodes.label: Latent Label Nonidentification
nodes.statement: For any finite latent input/output model and any bijection pi of its latent carrier, transporting the initial law, each intervention kernel and the emission kernel by pi leaves every finite observable input/output law unchanged. Hence an ungrounded latent name body/tool is not identified by the observable profile alone.
nodes.domain: Finite latent-state models with transported initial, transition and emission laws; semantic/anatomical predicates not included among observed grounded variables.
nodes.scope: Finite latent-state models with transported initial, transition and emission laws; semantic/anatomical predicates not included among observed grounded variables.
nodes.proof: Change variables z_t to pi(z_t) in the finite path sum. The verifier checks 1,024 deterministic two-state/two-input/binary-output length-three instances.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Independent physical grounding can identify protocol-relative causal roles; it still does not yield anatomy, complete organization or phenomenal ownership. Standard mathematics, no historical novelty claim.

nodes.label: Tokenwise C1 Application Boundary
nodes.statement: Given R159 frame-relation transport separately for each admitted trial and the R160 trial-family contract, each trial's grounded internal relation transports under its own h_omega. The cross-trial matrix S_Pi and its class do not thereby become one within-token experiential relation or an F_O contrast; a cross-trial correspondence, measurement bridge and fixed selected target are additional premises.
nodes.domain: Same declared trial family and per-trial bindings; no common K,D,Phi,h is presumed across different interventions/times.
nodes.scope: Same declared trial family and per-trial bindings; no common K,D,Phi,h is presumed across different interventions/times.
nodes.proof: Instantiate R159 tokenwise in each trial. Its quantifiers do not bind a single h across different actual tokens. Cross-trial causal contrasts therefore require an added comparison bridge.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not deny cross-trial science; it blocks an illicit object/time/signature substitution. No report-to-F or C1 verification follows.
